tour_name: Mendenhall Glacier Express (Shuttle + Time at Glacier)
description_short: Transfer to Mendenhall Glacier area with independent time for viewpoints and short walks.
description_long: A dependable option when you want glacier views without helicopter risk. Your real variable is traffic and crowds; the core advantage is predictability versus weather cancellations.
inclusions: Set amount of free time at the glacier area
requirements: Light walking if you want trails/views
Expect crowds during peak cruise days
